title: Is the iShares CLOA ETF a Buy After Richard Bernstein Advisors Loaded Up on 6.2 Million Shares?
author: Robert Izquierdo
description: Richard Bernstein Advisors acquired 6.2 million shares of the iShares AAA CLO Active ETF (CLOA) in Q1 2026, making it a top-five holding worth $320.66 million. The move signals bullish sentiment on the actively-managed ETF, which offers a 5.1% dividend yield and low volatility (0.03 beta) for income-focused investors seeking capital preservation with minimal risk.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Major institutional investor Richard Bernstein Advisors initiated a substantial $320.66 million position, elevating CLOA to a top-five holding. The ETF offers attractive features for income investors including a 5.1% dividend yield, low volatility (0.03 beta), and active management focused on capital preservation and credit quality.

title: Should ETF Investors Consider CLOs? Inspirion Opens $25 Million CLOA Position
author: Sarah Sidlow
description: Inspirion Wealth Advisors established a new $25.87 million position in BlackRock's iShares AAA CLO Active ETF (CLOA), acquiring 499,926 shares. The ETF, which focuses on AAA-rated collateralized loan obligations, offers a 5.35% dividend yield with monthly distributions, making it attractive for income-focused investors seeking stability over growth. CLOA has returned 5.43% over the past year but underperformed the S&P 500 by 13.76 percentage points.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: BlackRock's iShares AAA CLO Active ETF received a significant institutional investment of $25.87 million, demonstrating confidence in the fund's strategy and management expertise in credit markets.
